victor_narrative: Sold $402.8B last fiscal year; revenue is growing strongly (+15.1%).
For every $100 in sales, $33 is net profit — very profitable.
Generates real cash: $256.2B of free cash flow per year.
Owes $0.11 for every $1 of equity — low debt.
Quick score: 3.7/10, computed from 75 of 100 evidence points — categories without FMP data stay N/S (never fabricated).
If it keeps growing as it has and the market pays the same multiple, the stock would be worth ~$408.59 in 12 months (15% above the current price of $355.84).
